_doc: EXACT translation of MnO/mno_afm2_free_U0_ortho_chi_20260930.cmd (the saved command), D-ENV-RERUN 2026-10-04:

GPW_SPHERICAL=1 -> basis VALENCE_LOWQ_VA spherical;  MNO_SKIP_FM=1 -> (no arm concept: this deck is the AFM run);  MNO_REAL=0 -> solid.forceComplex;  MNO_MOM=0 MNO_ACC=Null -> useMOM false, accelerator Null;
MNO_PULAY=8 MNO_PULAY_START=5 -> pulayDepth/pulayStart;  MNO_EPS=1e-6 -> minDeltaRho (default measure: MNO_MEASURE was unset);  MNO_CHI=1 -> postSCF hubbardLinearResponse;

MNO_CHI_FD=1e-3 (Ha) -> hubbardFiniteDifference alpha_eV 0.027211386245988;  MNO_CHI_PERTURB=0 -> perturb [0];  every other knob at the probe's default (ortho CholeskyPivoted 1e-4, cutoff 2, imposition FREE, kT 5e-3, Kerker G0 1, relax 0.45, NMax 200).
MNO_U_RADIAL=ortho -> atomicRadial + orthoAtomic on both Mn d manifolds (HubbardU_OrthoAtomic);  MNO_SAVE=<path> -> state.save "auto" (the path is now <outDir>/states/<stem>.h5).
